risk_if_not_implemented: Without Assessor Access, the organization may fail to meet statutory, regulatory or contractual obligations, or be unable to demonstrate conformity when required. Based on the risk and threat mapping for this control, this deficiency most likely exposes the organization to Excessive or Unauthorized Privilege (R-AC-2), and most likely increases susceptibility to Dysfunctional Management Practices (MT-8), Human Error (MT-9).

compensating_control_1.name: Conformity Monitoring
compensating_control_1.description: Mechanisms exist to validate that Technology Assets, Applications, Services and/or Data (TAASD) conform to the organization's security, compliance and/or resilience policies, standards and other applicable requirements.
compensating_control_1.justification: Conformity Monitoring (CPL-05) provides periodic assessment and assurance that compensates for the absence of Assessor Access (CPL-10) by providing structured evaluation of the environment to surface gaps and verify residual control effectiveness. Given the process-oriented nature of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.

compensating_control_2.name: Risk Assessment Update
compensating_control_2.description: Mechanisms exist to routinely update risk assessments and react accordingly upon identifying new security vulnerabilities, including using outside sources for security vulnerability information.
compensating_control_2.justification: Risk Assessment Update (RSK-13.2) provides periodic assessment and assurance that compensates for the absence of Assessor Access (CPL-10) by providing structured evaluation of the environment to surface gaps and verify residual control effectiveness. Given the process-oriented nature of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.
